description: Master Data core module — module/feature registry (MVP) and healthcare reference data backbone (Post-launch). Module registry tables moved from Configurator per EM/tech lead decision. See 01-schema-design.md for rationale.

modules.description: Registry of all deployable modules — 4 core + ~38 feature modules from the AIIMS EOI scope. Platform-defined via deployment migrations.

name.description: Machine-readable name (e.g., opd, pharmacy, user_management). Used as module_id in APIs and events.

is_core.description: True for the 4 core modules (User Management, EMPI, Configurator, Master Data). Core modules cannot be disabled.

version.description: Current deployed version (semver). Updated by module deployment migrations.

indexes.name: idx_modules_category
indexes.note: Filter modules by category in admin UI

module_config_schemas.description: Each module's declared configuration schema. Modules register these during deployment. The Configurator reads these to render admin UI forms and validate tenant config values.

module_id.description: Module this schema belongs to. FK to modules.id.

schema_version.description: Semver version of this schema. New module versions may introduce new schema versions.

config_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 or later) defining the module's configurable parameters — types, defaults, constraints, UI hints.

defaults.description: Default values for all parameters. Used when a tenant has no explicit config for this module.

unique_constraints.name: uq_module_config_schemas_module_version
unique_constraints.note: One schema per module per version

indexes.name: idx_module_config_schemas_module
indexes.note: Look up all schema versions for a module

feature_flags.description: Platform-wide feature flag definitions with defaults. Tenant-specific overrides are in configurator.tenant_feature_flags.

name.description: Unique flag name (e.g., smart_parcha, ai_prescription_assist, opd_queue_v2)

description.description: What this flag controls and why it exists

flag_type.description: boolean = on/off, percentage = 0-100 gradual rollout, string = variant selection, json = complex config

default_value.description: Platform-wide default. Applied when no tenant-specific override exists.

module_id.description: Module this flag belongs to (NULL = platform-wide flag). FK to modules.id.

value_schema.description: JSON Schema for validating override values when flag_type = 'json'. NULL for non-JSON flag types. Same validation pattern as module_config_schemas.config_schema. Column ships in MVP; validation is Post-launch.

created_by.description: Platform operator who defined this flag (NULL for migration-seeded flags)

indexes.name: idx_feature_flags_name
indexes.note: Lookup by flag name (the primary access pattern)

indexes.name: idx_feature_flags_module
indexes.note: List all flags for a module

registry_change_audit.description: All module/feature registry changes — who registered/updated what, when. Master Data's audit trail for its MVP domain.

iq_tenant_id.description: Citus distribution key — the acting admin's tenant context from JWT. For migration-triggered changes: a designated platform-operations tenant ID.

entity_type.description: Type of registry entity that was changed

action.description: What was done to the entity

old_value.description: State before the change (null for 'created' actions)

changed_by.description: Admin who made the change (from JWT sub claim). NULL for migration-triggered changes.

indexes.name: idx_registry_change_audit_entity
indexes.note: All changes to a specific entity
